programme.title: Interview With a Killer

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: In the late 80's, Florida's cocaine imports were among the highest in the nation. Regional territories were enforced with intimidation and murder. Desperate to stop the violence, local authorities turned to the FBI for help. One dealer bowed to no one. He would stop at nothing to keep detectives and agents from building a case against him. When his organization began targeting the government itself, a city went on high alert.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: In Kokomo, Indiana an unthinkable crime terrified residents. A young woman was snatched from her home on a bright spring morning. Drops of blood and a torn window screen were all that was left to tell authorities what happened to the twenty-one year old victim. After several days of searching, a former FBI profiler narrowed the suspect list to one. Agents and detectives followed the trail across state lines hoping to find the victim before her time ran out.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: In July 1997, a triple murder terrified residents in the nation's capital. In a Georgetown coffee shop, three employees were shot to death. Investigators could find no immediate suspects and no clear motive for the attack. Evidence at the crime scene pointed in many different directions. Was this a hate crime, a robbery gone wrong, or an act of cold-blooded vengeance against one of the victims?

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: In 1986, a small crime free Indiana town was turned inside out by the arrival of one dangerous stranger. After an officer was gunned down at point-blank range, the psychotic killer led investigators across the Midwest. No one knew where the gunman would strike next, even as his tally of murders and abductions grew. The FBI and state police raced against time to rescue America's heartland from this deranged gunman, before he killed again.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: In Langley, Virginia, a gunman fired into rush hour traffic. The brazen daytime shooting of employees from the Central Intelligence Agency stunned the country. The victims seemed randomly selected, but the motive appeared to be political. The FBI was called in, but the nationwide search quickly became a far-reaching international manhunt. Agents processed more than 2000 leads and crossed an ocean in the effort to deliver justice.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: On the day before Thanksgiving, a mother discovered her 10 year-old son was missing from his school. No one knew how it could have happened. Within hours, the boy's entire family was frantically searching for him. The few leads in the case quickly turned cold and the FBI was called in to aid in the investigation. The search by agents and local authorities would cover a thousand miles to expose the kidnapper and find the missing child.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: On a summer afternoon in upscale Lodi, California, a 12-year-old girl is abducted from her home. Scores of police officers and FBI agents converge, determined to find the young girl before it is too late. When the kidnapper's car is discovered in a field near Lodi, police dogs, helicopters, and hundreds of volunteers are employed in a round-the-clock search. It would take a community united in concern for one of their youngest to find the missing child.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: In rural Texas, 13-year-old is kidnapped on her way to school. Frantic to find her safely, her millionaire father calls local authorities and the FBI. As police officers and agents conduct aerial surveillance, the father drives hundreds of miles through the night to deliver the ransom cash to a drop that the kidnappers keep changing. In a final effort to save the young girl, investigators must engage in a dangerous firefight with five desperate criminals.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: In September 1997, a team of masked gunmen robbed an armored car facility in Los Angeles, and made off with $18.9 million, the largest takeover heist in U.S. history. An employee believed she recognized the voice of one of the robbers, and FBI agents began conducting surveillance on a former employee of the facility. With only one piece of physical evidence, a fragment of a vehicle taillight, authorities hoped to connect him to the crime, and locate his accomplices.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: In July 1996, two men entered a pawnshop in Birmingham, Alabama, and ruthlessly murdered the employees. Unbeknownst to the killers, a secret video surveillance camera recorded the shooting. Local police and the FBI released images of the crime to the media, and were quickly able to identify the perpetrators. Now authorities had to find two cold-blooded killers who knew that they were being pursued for murder one.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: In Lincoln County, Nebraska, a fugitive drug dealer engaged in a shootout with state troopers, wounding two of them, and eluded capture after a high-speed chase. Authorities immediately set up a statewide manhunt, connecting the fugitive to a murder in western Nebraska. A chance sighting led FBI agents to a second confrontation with the killer, who was more determined than ever to escape the law.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: After a career criminal committed a vehicular homicide in New Orleans, FBI agents tracked him through his habits and addictions. They focused their investigation on gambling communities throughout the country and, when he resurfaced in Atlantic City, authorities used all of their resources to trap an elusive sociopath who claimed that he would never be taken alive.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: In the early 1980's, a pair of serial bank robbers gained a reputation among law enforcement officials as formidable bandits. Using the same modus operandi, the two men took hostages and emptied bank vaults across the Midwest. After the criminals escaped from police custody, FBI agents familiar with the bandits believed that they would attempt a grand-scale heist. By conducting surveillance on known associates of the criminals, authorities tried to anticipate the next target.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: In the summer of 1999, Texas was terrorized by a brutal serial killer who traveled by train. The FBI assembled a task force to gather information about the dangerous drifter and create a profile that would help locate him. As they learned that the killer had traveled extensively through the United States and Mexico, the murders became more frequent, and authorities had to cast a dragnet over an entire continent in an effort to catch him.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: On October 2, 1987, a Boston police officer responding to a domestic disturbance call was fatally wounded. Local authorities launched a citywide manhunt, but were only able to find the fingerprints of the chief suspect. Believing that he had fled the area, the FBI followed the suspect's trail to the west coast and then across the Mexican border, always aware of the desperation of a cop killer and of the need for justice.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: In August 1984, the son of a successful real estate developer was kidnapped in front of his father's business in Miami. After the father received a $3 million ransom demand from a self-proclaimed terrorist, the FBI became involved. Based on witness descriptions of the car used in the kidnapping, authorities began to suspect a pair of Colombian nationals with a known grudge against the developer's family.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: In October 1995, a South Carolina family was taken hostage as part of an elaborately planned bank robbery. Local police quickly identified two of the perpetrators, but the criminal mastermind proved more elusive. After his escape from custody, authorities began to suspect the fugitive of involvement in a series of bank robberies up and down the east coast, and the FBI remained on his trail, hoping to catch him before he took more hostages.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: In February 1988, a record store clerk in Sandusky, Ohio, was fatally shot in his van. After discovering a night deposit bag with thousands of dollars in the vehicle, police knew that robbery was not the motive, and began to investigate other possibilities. programme.title: The FBI Files

When this prediction came true, the FBI agent noted behavioral clues, hoping that they could lead him to the kidnapper.

programme.title: The FBI Files

programme.title: The FBI Files

programme.title: The FBI Files

programme.title: The FBI Files

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Åre
programme.desc: Sweden’s largest ski resort Åre is well known for its local ingredients, boasting the highest number of organic food producers per capita in Sweden. The fresh water and clean air create unique conditions for growing excellent food.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: The Danish Lakelands
programme.desc: The Danish Lakelands produce some of the finest ingredients that you can find. Tareq has a go at an old cooking technique from New Zealand called Hangi - using heated rocks buried in a pit oven.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: West Sweden
programme.desc: Gothenburg on the west coast of Sweden has recently been discovered as an exciting destination by both international travel journalists and food bloggers. Tareq tracks down an old army barracks which has been converted into a world class cheese factory.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Luleå
programme.desc: Tareq visits Luleå, home to the beautiful Tree Hotel: a collection of treehouses built by an award winning architect. Following the river further up into the mountains he reaches the land where, for centuries, the Sami people kept their reindeer herds.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Halmstad
programme.desc: In Halmstad Tareq explores the contrast between the busy summer scene at the beach and the quiet rural country life, meeting Jörgen Persson: award winning table tennis player and visiting a village famous for its cheese.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Kemi
programme.desc: Kemi is situated in northern Finland by the Bothnian Bay and it is part of Lapland region. Tareq tries his luck at a spot of burbot fishing on the frozen sea and visits the snow castle hotel.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: West Sweden
programme.desc: Situated on the west coast of Sweden, Bohuslän is a place where you can really feel the history of fishing all around a tradition that is still active. Tareq will be harvesting supreme quality oysters and lobsters and cook some wonderful seafood dishes.

programme.title: iCarly: iCarly får britisk besøg
programme.desc: Carly får en smitsom sygdom og kommer til at smitte et medlem fra band One Direction. Imens skal Spencer træne en lille pige, der ikke kan fordrage at motionere.

programme.title: iCarly: Skolerestauranten
programme.desc: Gibby åbner en hemmelig restaurant i skolens kælder med Sams hjælp. Og Spencer designer en vagtrobot til loftet, der mod al forventning går grassat.

programme.title: iCarly: Aprilsnar
programme.desc: I det her specielle aprilsnar-afsnit bliver Carly og Spencer sat på gaden, så slænget mindes deres tid i Bushwell Plaza. Men deres minder er ikke helt, som vi husker dem.

programme.title: iCarly: iPære-butikken
programme.desc: Freddies nye drømmejob i Pear Store bliver et mareridt, når Sam også bliver ansat. Imens prøver Carly at blive inviteret ud af en fra Pear Store, og Spencer skal melde sig som frivillig på den lokale brandstation.

programme.title: iCarly: Halvenween
programme.desc: iCarly-slænget holder en "Halfoween"-fest, for de synes, at det skal være Halloween to gange om året. Men da en forklædt gæst snører Carly og vennerne, bliver festen lidt for vild.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: Frankensteins eksperiment

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: Monstre iblandt os

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: Når verdener støder sammen Del 1
programme.desc: Mona Lisa ankommer pludselig til Jorden, og Raph er så ivrig efter at hjælpe, at han ender med at få bragt holdet i endnu større vanskeligheder.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: Når verdener støder sammen Del 2
programme.desc: Raph må få Mona Lisa og Bishop til at arbejde sammen for at besejre en trussel fra rummet og redde Jorden.

programme.title: Tosh.0: 4

programme.title: Tosh.0: 'Men's Rights Lawyer'
programme.desc: Daniel hyrer juristen som er feministernes værste mareridt, møder USA's mest gasfyldte pige og pifter tegnsproget op med nogle flere stødende udtryk.

programme.title: Tosh.0: Mini Bike Jump
programme.desc: Daniel giver oprejsning til en bikerdame, som sprang for tæt på solen (og blev forbrændt), leger den eneste leg, som kan som kan befri verden for racisme og had og viser den mest sexede ting siden skiveskåret brød.

programme.title: Tosh.0: 7
programme.desc: Daniel finder ud af om en hardbody har en blød side, beviser at andre kulturers bryllupstraditioner er lige så skrækkelige som de amerikanske og afslører, hvorfor han er den perfekte at gå i seng med i en nødsituation.

programme.title: Tosh.0: 8
programme.desc: Daniel er retro og har skovhuggerjakke på i rød og sort (med matchende kasket) og præsenterer en ny republikansk præsidentkandidat.

programme.title: Tosh.0: Catcaller
programme.desc: Daniel råber efter en pifter og frigør toiletter fra chauvinistiske kønsrollers tyranni.

programme.title: Tosh.0: 10
programme.desc: I sæsonens sidste afsnit før Daniel holder forårsferie, får han lektioner om livet af en tysk partyprins, går ind på tv-spilsmarkedet og siger farvel til skovhuggermode.

programme.title: Tosh.0: 11
programme.desc: Daniel giver en meget højlydt Hillary Clinton-supporter genoprejsning, terroriserer Broadway og giver fans en chance for at skrive en hilsen i sin årbog.

programme.title: Tosh.0: 12

programme.title: The Roast of Rob Lowe

programme.title: Man with a plan

programme.title: Man with a plan

programme.title: Man with a plan

programme.title: The Hills: Once a Player
programme.desc: Lauren tror, at Brody måske er for meget playboy for hende. Spencers søster fortæller hende, at Heidi er i tvivl om deres bryllup.

programme.title: The Hills: When One Door Closes...
programme.desc: Lauren får en god nyhed til Teen Vogue og Heidi har brug for noget tid væk fra Spencer.

programme.desc: Lauren kommer endelig af sted til Paris, men turen bliver næsten ødelagt da hun finder ud af, at Brody har fundet en anden. Spencer følger Heidi til Colorado for at prøve at vinde hende tilbage, men hans plan slår fejl.

programme.title: The Hills: Back to L.A.
programme.desc: Whitney må vælge mellem Teen Vogue og risikoen forbundet med at gå efter en ny karriere. Lauren og Brody skændes over hans nye kæreste og Heidi vænner sig til livet uden Spencer.

programme.title: The Hills: An Unexpected Friend
programme.desc: Lauren får en uventet ven, da Spencers søster, Stephanie, går til de samme timer som hende. Whitney tror, at hendes nye job vil opfylde alle hendes drømme.

programme.title: The Hills: When Spencer Finds Out...

programme.desc: Heidi prøver at vinde Audrinas venskab tilbage, men Lauren tvivler på Heidis motiver. Whitney er ved at vænne sig til sit nye job, men savner stadig at arbejde sammen med Lauren.

programme.title: The Hills: Girls' Night Out
programme.desc: Heidi elsker at være single, men da hun ser Spencer sammen med andre piger bliver hun jaloux. Whitney beder om Laurens hjælp til modeugen i LA.

programme.title: The Hills: A New Roommate

programme.desc: Tragedien rammer, da Alex bliver skudt af en tidligere fange, som holder hende ansvarlig for hans fængselsdom, netop som Walker langt om længe skal til at fri til hende.

programme.title: Boligkøb i blinde: Episode 504
programme.desc: Laura og Jesper og Jespers to børn bor til leje i Humlebæk, og det er de mildest talt trætte af. De mangler plads, have – og de vil også gerne have børn sammen snart. Men to års boligjagt har ikke givet bonus.

programme.title: Boligkøb i blinde: Episode 505
programme.desc: Ulla og Kristian bor i en smuk herskabslejlighed på Frederiksberg med deres to børn. Men de ønsker sig mere plads i et børnevenligt kvarter i cykelafstand til indre by. Kan Tobias Edlev-Nielsen finde et hus til dem?

programme.title: Boligkøb i blinde: Episode 506
programme.desc: En lille lejebolig i Vanløse og to små børn – det er ikke det bedste match. Lisa og Erling drømmer om et stort hus med stor have. Tobias kommer på hårdt arbejde, for drømmene er en hel del større end budgettet.

programme.title: Boligkøb i blinde: Episode 601
programme.desc: Nathja, Kristian og deres nyfødte datter bor i en ombygget butik med en faldstamme i soveværelset. Kristian drømmer om en kæmpe garage, og Nathja vil helst blive i Køge – kan Tobias opfylde deres drømme?

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Florø
programme.desc: Tareq visits Norway and Florø to celebrate their national day -17th of May. Surrounded by breathtaking archipelagos and stunning fjords he dives for scallops in the north sea, cooking at mountain peaks and exploring the history of norwegian salmon

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Estonia
programme.desc: Tareq makes his way across the baltic sea to Estonia and the capital Tallinn. He discovers the historical treasures of the city and its thriving culinary life before he heads out into the vast and beautiful countryside and the national park of Soomaa.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Ringkøbing
programme.desc: Ringkøbing, a lovely old market town located at the west coast of Denmark. Here, Tareq visit a traditional Herring Festival and meets up with local entrepreneurs who have learned to adapt to this ever-changing environment.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Falkenberg
programme.desc: Something is definitely happening in Falkenberg on the west coast of Sweden. Over the last couple of years it have become somewhat of a haven for foodies. Tareq is on a mission; taking him through a fertile landscape with vineyards and salmon fishing.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Estonia (Part 2)
programme.desc: Estonia has embarked on a journey greatly inspired by the nordic cuisine. Tareq explores the countryside of Estonia before he returns to the capital of Tallinn where he meets people that really love their traditional food.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Öland
programme.desc: Tareq bikes through the unique landscape of Öland, Sweden's second largest island located in the Baltic Sea. It is a place where the interaction between man and nature have created a diverse and rich farmland with an amazing amount of small producers.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Bornholm
programme.desc: Bornholm, the sunny bright green island with it’s own gastronomic tone is a true pioneer when it comes to local food at it’s finest quality. Tareq visit Denmark's first regional food culture house where they develop this unique flourishing cuisine.

programme.title: Med kniven for struben: Episode 102

programme.title: Med kniven for struben: Episode 202

programme.title: Med kniven for struben: Episode 206
programme.desc: Brødrene Rene og Martin åbnede sidste år deres første restaurant i Jyllinge havn. Efter en lovende start kører stedet nu med underskud.

programme.title: Med kniven for struben: Episode 502
programme.desc: På Orø Kro har de et blakket ry. De lokale holder sig væk, og en madanmelder har for nylig givet restauranten to stjerner i en landsdækkende avis.

programme.title: Jersey Shore: Free Vinny

programme.title: Ridiculousness

programme.title: Ridiculousness

programme.title: Ridiculousness

programme.title: The Hills: A Date With The Past

programme.title: The Hills: No Place Like Home

programme.title: The Hills: The Next Move Is Yours
programme.desc: I sæsonens sidste afsnit føler Audrina sig lukket ude af Laurens venskab med Lo, og hun overvejer at flytte ud. Lauren gør et sidste forsøg på at blive god venner med Audrina, men måske er det for sent.

programme.title: The Hills: We'll Never Be Friends
programme.desc: Da sæson fire starter er situationen mellem Audrina og Lo anspændt. Lauren forsøger at gøre et godt indtryk på en ny fyr, og et besøg fra Heidis søster Holly truer Spencer og Heidis forhold.

programme.title: The Hills: Drama Follows Them
programme.desc: Stephanie bliver uvenner med sin bror og hans ven da Lauren møder Spencer på sin fødselsdag. Kelly Cutrone fyrer en fra People's Revolution og Whitney overtager stillingen. Laurens forhold til Doug udvikler sig lidt for hurtigt.

programme.title: The Hills: Better Off As Friends
programme.desc: Lauren indser at den kemi, hun havde med Doug på studiet ikke længere er der. Whitney er nervøs for at tage til New York, men en date med en model gør hende gladere. Til trods for forsoningsgestusen vil Spencer bryde helt med Stephanie.

programme.title: The Hills: Boys Make Girls Cry
programme.desc: En vild tur til Las Vegas går galt, da Audrina ignorerer Lauren. Brody nævner Stephanies fortid, og drengene ryger i brummen. Heidis søster Holly flytter ind, men det er intet Spencer hellere vil end at smide hende ud.

programme.title: The Hills: Something Has To Change
programme.desc: Lauren og Audrina kæmper for at redde deres venskab, men det kan allerede være for sent. Spencer har fået nok af Heidis søster Holly og tager sagen i egne hænder. Og Brody og Doug forlader fængslet med nye historier.

programme.title: The Hills: You Always Miss a Best Friend
programme.desc: Heidis søster Holly tager kontakt med Lauren, noget som tvinger både Lauren og Heidi til at revurdere hvad der er sket med dere venskab.. Audrina og Justins forhold bliver sat på prøve, da hun arbejder på en event for Epic Records.

programme.title: The Hills: When Lauren's Away...
programme.desc: Da Lauren tager på ferie med familien, går alting galt i Los Angeles. Stephanie dater Doug bag Laurens rygg, og Audrina og Heidi bliver venner.

programme.title: Boligkøb i blinde: Episode 603

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Laponia
programme.desc: In the northern part of Sweden, you’ll find the stunning world heritage Laponia. Almost 10.000 square kilometres of nature reserves and national parks. Tareq visit the rich, unique culture of the sami in the vast impressive wilderness.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Malmö & Copenhagen
programme.desc: Tareq Taylor returns to his home turf to see what has happened and what the future might bring to the new nordic cuisine. He visits a local goat farmer and meets up with young enthusiastic chefs who takes this nordic legacy further.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Zealand
programme.desc: Tareq Taylor visits the South Coast of Denmark to make his own versions of open-faced sandwiches and smoked fish dishes.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Dalsland
programme.desc: Tareq Taylor puts on his hiking boots and explores the pilgrim trail of Dalsland in West Sweden. This episode will include outdoor cooking, foraging and beaver safari.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Stockholm
programme.desc: When Tareq arrives in Stockholm he will meet innovation and world class gastronomy, a big city for foodies. He will make some pizza at the Rosendal garden café and go on an adventure in the archipielago.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Lolland
programme.desc: When Michelin star chefs move from Copenhagen to the countryside, they often end up in Lolland/Falster. Here Tareq will meet Claus Meyer the father of new nordic cuisine and other entrepreneurs that opened interesting restaurants here.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Skåne
programme.desc: Tareq Taylor explores his own backyard of Skåne and hometown of Malmö, a multi cultural food mix. Here you can find food and culture from all over the world that makes it a unique culinary destination.

programme.title: Med kniven for struben: Episode 703

programme.desc: The investigation into the kidnapping and rape of an 18-year-old Ohio woman is aided when the victim returns hours after the incident occurred. With her help, the police are able to track the assailant to his front door.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Smiley Face
programme.desc: The woman had been sexually assaulted, stabbed repeatedly and left for dead. When a perfect suspect practically turned himself in, police were sure they had their man until DNA evidence proved them wrong.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Terror In Disguise
programme.desc: Banks use a variety of devices to discourage would-be robbers: security cameras, silent alarms, and exploding dye packs. But when an elusive bank robber targeted Seattle's banks, none of these precautions were effective.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Under Fire
programme.desc: A series of armored car heists and bloody shoot-outs shocked law enforcement. The brutal violence of the crimes suggested a motive more complex than greed. When the robbers started targeting police, the FBI took charge.

programme.title: The FBI Files: A Stranger in Town
programme.desc: She appeared on the highway in the spring, a young woman, her life cut short, her past and her identity a mystery. Only by finding out who she was could we ever hope to find her killer.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Manhunt
programme.desc: A killer was on the loose in one of America's most popular tourist destinations. Armed and desperate, he evaded law enforcement at every turn. As the Fourth of July weekend quickly approached, thousands of people became potential targets.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Women Who Kill

programme.title: The New Detectives: Deadly Dealings
programme.desc: For a price, anything's possible. Contract killings arose out of the need to establish the perfect alibi. By hiring someone else to do the dirty work, a person can deflect guilt, at least in theory.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Body Count
programme.desc: Some people do get away with murder, at least for a while. Flush with their success, serial killers murder again and again. But each time they kill, they leave behind a few more clues, which ultimately lead to their undoing.

programme.title: The New Detectives: A Taste of Poison

programme.title: Dr. G: Medical Examiner

programme.title: Dr. G: Medical Examiner

programme.title: Dr. G: Medical Examiner

programme.title: Dr. G: Medical Examiner

programme.title: Rachel Shannon True Crime
programme.desc: When Mengqi Ji vanished, her husband claimed she walked out on him. But cell phone data, muddy boots, and a juniper tree in a state park told a very different story. A solved true crime case about control, lies, and justice.

programme.title: Rachel Shannon True Crime
programme.desc: Alice Ruggles was stalked and murdered by her obsessive ex-boyfriend after the system failed to protect her. Her family now fights to make sure it doesn't happen again. A solved true crime case everyone needs to hear.

programme.desc: Audrina får sit eget sted, og håber, at Justin vil flytte ind hos hende, men alle frygter, at hun flytter af den forkerte grund. Heidi inviterer Spencer til et arrangement med arbejdet og bliver taget i at have det lidt for sjovt.

programme.title: Boligkøb i blinde: Episode 605

programme.title: Boligkøb i blinde: Episode 701
programme.desc: Cecilie og Kristoffer bor med deres lille søn i en træt lejlighed i Århus, men drømmer om plads og ro. Men hvor rolig bliver man, når man pludselig ejer et hus, man slet ikke føler sig hjemme i?

programme.title: Boligkøb i blinde: Episode 702
programme.desc: Bianca og Morten bor i Randers med tung trafik, der suser forbi udenfor - og to små piger, der har lært at åbne hoveddøren. Det dur ikke, og derfor har de bedt Boligkøb i blindes eksperter om hjælp.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Best Of
programme.desc: Tareq Taylor looks back on some of the food adventures he has been part of in the program series Nordic Cookery. Tareq promises delicacies from all over the Nordics and meetings with fantastic people along the way.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Läckö & Kinnekulle
programme.desc: By Lake Vänern you find Läckö and Kinnekulle, an area rich in history, culture and traditions. Tareq cooks exciting dishes on vendice roe, fish and local cheeses - all served on porcelain from the world-famous Rörstrand.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Sjuhärad
programme.desc: Sjuhärad is nature and culture in perfect symbiosis. Tareq takes the bike to meet some of the food entrepreneurs in the area who have started exciting new businesses. Here you live close to nature, forest and lakes.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Greater Copenhagen
programme.desc: Copenhagen and Skåne are a hot food destinations. Tareq visits Østergro, Denmark's first "rooftop farm" in the middle of Copenhagen, Eden in the new district Hyllie, Malmö and Häckeberga Castle where there will be wild boar for dinner.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Höganäs
programme.desc: The wild coast at Kullaberg in Skåne has a lot of culture and gastronomy to offer. Fantastic ceramics, vineyards and world-class ice cream. Tareq visits VikenTomater and cooks vegetarian ragù

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Karlstad
programme.desc: Tareq visits sunny Karlstad! Here, food is prepared by Vänern's shores and in Värmland's deep forests. Butter-fried Zander, crepes and cooking over an open fire are on the menu.

programme.title: Med kniven for struben: Episode 103

programme.title: Med kniven for struben: Episode 506

programme.title: Secret War: Hardy Amies and Operation Ratweek
programme.desc: Operation Ratweek’s existence has always been denied. However WMR has now discovered evidence that it existed and was carried out.

programme.title: WWII's The Great Escapes: The Freedom Trails: Italy: Operation Galia
programme.desc: Monty’s journey sees him follow the path 33 SAS soldiers took after they were parachuted behind enemy lines to attack the enemy and create chaos to draw Nazi-fascist forces away from the front line.

programme.title: Secret War: Agent Garbo
programme.desc: Juan Pujol, MI6's WWII agent "Garbo," created a fictitious spy network in Lisbon, deceiving the Germans with crucial disinformation and influencing their strategies. After the war, MI6 protected him, and he lived in Venezuela until his death in 1988.

programme.title: Rachel Shannon True Crime
programme.desc: A 16-year-old calls 911 claiming an intruder killed her mom and her mom's boyfriend. But bloody footprints and security footage told a very different story. A true crime case built on lies that unraveled fast.

programme.title: Gabulosis: Florida’s Oldest Missing Child Case That Still Has No Answers: The Puzzling Case of "Jon Jon" Hagans
programme.desc: On June 11, 1968 Jonathan "Jon Jon" Hagans vanished from Jacksonville Beach during a day out in the sun with his loved ones. Authorities wanted to say the waves swept him away but his family never agreed with that theory.

programme.title: Mollie Westbrook
programme.desc: In 1994, 6-year-old Rikki Neave was strangled by 13-year-old James Watson in Peterborough, England. His mother was wrongly accused. DNA evidence eventually solved the case in 2022, nearly 30 years later.

programme.title: Gabulosis: A Summer Boy Scout Trip That Turned Into a Decades Long Mystery: What Happened to Garrett Bardsley?
programme.desc: On August 20, 2004 Garrett Bardsley told his father he was going to walk back to camp to change his clothes after falling in the water while they were fishing. He was never seen again and no clues have ever surfaced.

programme.title: Gabulosis: Canada's Oldest Investigation Solved By Genetic Genealogy
programme.desc: In June 2006, construction workers in Sutherland, Saskatoon, Canada uncovered the remains of an unidentified woman from the early 1900s. Her name and story remained a mystery for another 19 years.

programme.title: Gabulosis: Wembley Point Woman: The Woman Who Jumped from a London Building and Was Never Identified
programme.desc: On October 29, 2004 a woman jumped from a window at the top floor of the Wembley Point Tower in London. Her identity is still unknown to this day.

programme.title: Mollie Westbrook
programme.desc: In June 1984, 15-year-old cheerleader Kirsten Costas was lured out and stabbed five times by jealous classmate Bernadette Protti in Orinda, California. The case inspired the TV movie Death of a Cheerleader.

programme.title: Awkward: Resolutions
programme.desc: Jenna undgår at beskæftige sig med afsløringen af, at hendes mor skrev konfrontationsbrevet. I stedet spreder hun julehumør og nytårsstemning, indtil Jakes gave tvinger hende til at beslutte, om hun er klar til at glemme Matty helt.

programme.title: Awkward: Sex, Lies and the Sanctuary
programme.desc: Jenna nyder, at forholdet med Jake endelig er blevet officielt, indtil hun hører om de seneste måneders skjulte kameraoptagelser fra Sanctuary. Hun går derefter ekstremt til værks - og hverver bl.a. Ming - for ødelægge båndet.

programme.title: Awkward: Three's a Crowd
programme.desc: Jenna prøver at slutte fred med Matty og behage Jake, men har svært ved at ignorere Mattys evindelige flirten og klæbrige opførsel. Hans handlinger får hende til at stille spørgsmålstegn ved, hvem der egentligt er problemet i trioen.

programme.title: Awkward: Are You There God? It's Me, Jenna
programme.desc: Jenna er stadig ikke kommet sig over sine forældres separation og føler sig ansvarlig. I et impulsivt forsøg på at tilgive sig selv søger hun tilflugt fra sine problemer hos de højere magter i den religiøse lejrskole.

programme.title: Awkward: My Love is a Black Heart
programme.desc: Jenna forbereder sig på sin første Valentinsdag med en kæreste, men både hun og Tamara bliver jaloux, da det går op for dem, at deres ekskærester måske er ved at være klar til at komme videre med deres liv og glemme dem.

programme.title: Awkward: What Comes First: Sex or Love?
programme.desc: Jenna har stadig ikke genfundet sit fodfæste efter Jakes kærlighedserklæring, og hun overvejer, om det at have sex med ham vil give hende klarhed om sine egne følelser.

programme.title: Awkward: Another one Bites the Dust
programme.desc: Jenna er klar til at have sex med Jake efter endelig at have fået klarhed over sine følelser. Hendes beslutsomhed bliver imidlertid grundigt testet af tante Allys bryllup, en mand fra hendes mors fortid og en intrigant Sadie.

programme.title: Awkward: Time After Time
programme.desc: Dårlig timing og afsløringer efterlader både Jenna og Jake knuste.

programme.title: Awkward: Homewrecker Hamilton
programme.desc: Jenna har svært ved at rede trådene ud i sit forskruede kærlighedsliv efter brud og genforeninger med drengene - lige indtil en uventet tekst placerer hendes dramatiske liv lige midt i rampelyset.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Lund
programme.desc: In this episode, Tareq visits Lund, a thousand-year old city in southern Sweden. Lund is surrounded by the richest farmland in the country, and we explore nearby islands and meet entrepreneurs making highly-regarded local products.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Bornholm
programme.desc: Tareq sails out to Bornholm, a Danish island close to southern tip of Sweden. The islanders are fiercely self-sufficient and this attitude reflects in the huge number of food producers making products that are sold both locally and internationally.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Jokkmokk

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Åland
programme.desc: For hundreds of years, Åland’s shipping fleet was the envy of navies around the world, and their sea trade was encouraged by the seafood, grains and fruits that thrive on these islands. Tareq prepares recipes to reflect Åland’s unique cuisine.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Malmö
programme.desc: Tareq is in his hometown of Malmö – Sweden’s third largest city. The food scene here is inspired by the traditional seafood dishes and the large immigrant population whose recipes have given Malmö a new energy.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Finland's South Coast
programme.desc: Tareq takes a late autumn trip along Finland’s southern coast. He stops in the capital Helsinki to see how the city's food culture is about to be discovered by the rest of the world, and dives into the freezing waters around Ekenäs.

programme.desc: En ensom enke har planlagt å reise jorden rundt med sin ektemanns aske for å besøke alle de stedene de falt for i filmer de så sammen. Det første stoppet forandrer livet hennes for alltid.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: And When the Sky Was Opened
programme.desc: Three astronauts have returned from this first space flight. Major Gart is hospitalized with a broken leg. The other two, Colonels Harrington and Forbes head for a bar. Harrington gets a strange feeling…

programme.title: Exploring with Fighters

programme.title: Steve Ronin
programme.desc: Exploring an abandoned 1910 Spanish Revival mansion with dark secrets, marble staircases, hidden rooms, and rumored ties to JFK and mysterious societies.

programme.desc: Hidden in County Wicklow's woods, this eerie Irish sculpture park features massive black granite statues exploring birth, death, and the darker sides of the human mind. Designed for adult reflection, every figure tells a deeply thought-provoking story.

programme.title: Exploring the Unbeaten Path
programme.desc: Exploring one of the world’s most amazing abandoned theme parks in China, built to rival Disney but abandoned after going bankrupt just a few years later.

programme.title: Exploring with Fighters
programme.desc: In Japan's Fukushima radiation zone, urban explorers document abandoned JDM cars left since the 2011 nuclear disaster. Geiger counter in hand, they discover rare models including an R32 GTR and an Evo VII frozen in time.

programme.title: Andromeda: Så brenn de utemmede landene

programme.desc: Tunneler oppdages på Seefra som kan brukes til å nå åtte andre Seefra-planeter.

programme.desc: Rhade leder opprørerne i en kamp mot en krigsherre på Seefra-5.

programme.desc: Dylan oppdager at kjæresten til Beka var Drago Musevini, og han brukte Bekas DNA til å skape Nietzscheans.

programme.desc: Bekkastan, 1401 e.Kr.: krigerprinsesse Kahina beviser sin rett til å herske. 2002: Sydney og Nigel avdekker et hulemaleri som kan føre dem til Kahinas sal. Men hennes etterkommere forårsaker komplikasjoner.

programme.title: Andromeda: Dommens dag, Vredens dag
programme.desc: Mannskapet installerer en ny AI i et nytt Commonwealth-slagskip, og naturlig nok går ikke ting som de skal.

programme.title: Andromeda: Skygger kastet av en siste hilsen
programme.desc: Tyr overbeviser Nietzscheans at han er reinkarnasjonen til Drago Museveni.

programme.title: Andromeda: Svar gitt på spørsmål som aldri er stilt
programme.desc: En melding fra en samler sender Dylan på et oppdrag for å redde et gissel og finne restene av Commonwealth-flåten.

programme.title: Andromeda: Biter av åtte
programme.desc: Citizen Eight prøver å fjerne Dylan fra kommandoen over Andromeda.

programme.title: Walker Texas Ranger: Texas mot Cahill
programme.desc: Alex blir funnet til sengs med en død mann, og avtrykkene hennes er på våpenet som drepte ham. Det er opp til faren hennes, Gordon Cahill, å forsvare henne i retten.

programme.title: Walker Texas Ranger
programme.desc: Walkers tidligere elev uteksamineres fra politiakademiet, og Walker velger å gi ham et viktig, men vanskelig oppdrag: å ødelegge doplangeres planer om å dele ut gratis heroin på skolene.

programme.title: Walker Texas Ranger: De kjempende McLains
programme.desc: Etter at Walker fanger en desertert marineoffiser, JW McLain, som er besatt av å ta hevn over Jack Garrett, mannen som drepte storesøsteren hans, klarer McLain å rømme.

programme.title: Walker Texas Ranger: Ismannen
programme.desc: Walker oppdager at vennen hans, den tidligere straffedømte Charlie Brooks, er helt lik Iceman, og han overtaler Charlie til å spille ham i et forsøk på å avslutte mafiabossens terrorvelde.

programme.title: Mission: Impossible: Time Bomb
programme.desc: To head off a threatened atomic blast, Jim Phelps gains entry to a top secret nuclear plant by posing as a temperamental artist with guest star Barbara Luna as his model on Paramount Television's "Mission: Impossible."

programme.title: Mission: Impossible: The Amnesiac
programme.desc: As a doctor with a startling new treatment for amnesia, Jim Phelps forces Paris to relive another man's past when the IMF pushes a search for stolen nuclear material on Paramount Television's "Mission: Impossible."

programme.title: Mission: Impossible: Chico
programme.desc: A dog that collects rare stamps -- on command from the IMF -- figures in a perilous journey to the stronghold of a narcotics kingpin (guest star Fernando Lamas) on Paramount Television's "Mission: Impossible."

programme.title: Mission: Impossible: Terror
programme.desc: To calm a Middle East trouble spot, the IMF tries to keep a man in prison long enough to make it look as though he is trying to break out on Paramount Television's "Mission: Impossible."

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Nynäshamn
programme.desc: Sunny Nynäshamn is a resort town close to Stockholm, but there is more here than the sea. Tareq meets a prize-winning chocolate maker using ingredients from her garden, visits a thriving local food market, and gets a lesson in how to smoke fish.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Røros
programme.desc: Born as a mining town in the 17th century, Røros is now a center for local and organic food producers. Tareq tries dairy products which Michelin-starred chefs swear by, goes skiing and sledding around Røros many hilly streets

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Vimmerby
programme.desc: Vimmerby is known as the birthplace of beloved author Astrid Lindgren. Tareq finds that the area is also well-regarded for its cuisine. From the children’s theme park to the friendly moose that roam the hills, Vimmerby has a lot to offer visitors.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Trysil
programme.desc: The mountains and snowfall in Trysil mean that the town has to be creative with food; Tareq learns how to make cheese in the traditional way, and goes skiing of course, and takes to the slopes to cook something as skiers pass by.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Värmland
programme.desc: Värmland is home to many of Sweden’s most famous authors and inventors. However, it is also a place with a rich food culture. Tareq gets his hands on a very rare bird to cook and also takes time out to float down a tranquil river on a wooden raft.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Fyn
programme.desc: Tareq visits Fyn, the fairy tale capital of the world. Famous as the birthplace of Hans Christian Andersen, Fyn is also known as the garden of Denmark. Here we explore stunning nature and world class cuisine.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Höga Kusten
programme.desc: Created thousands of years ago, the High Coast in the northern part of Sweden is the highest coast in the world. Tareq sets out to sample one of the most extreme types of Swedish food, fermented herring.

programme.title: The Love Boat: A Day In Port

programme.title: Rachel Shannon True Crime

programme.title: Mollie Westbrook
programme.desc: Illinois serial killer Bruce Lindahl accidentally severed his own femoral artery while stabbing a victim in 1981, dying on the spot. Decades later, DNA forensics posthumously linked him to over 12 murders.

programme.title: Rachel Shannon True Crime

programme.title: The Devil Bat
programme.desc: Dr. Paul Carruthers is cheated by his employers after developing a new aftershave lotion, so he seeks revenge by using a giant killer bat to kill anyone wearing the lotion.

programme.title: White Zombie
programme.desc: A plantation owner desires another man's bride and enlists the help of a witch doctor to use a mind-control potion to make her fall in love with him. Instead, the witch doctor turns against them both.

programme.title: The Hills: New City, New Drama
programme.desc: Når Lauren Conrad må mestre både moteskolen, en krevende praktikantjobb og en uforutsigbar romkamerat som ødelegger for henne, forstår hun raskt at alt er stort i Los Angeles, også hennes egne problemer.

programme.title: The Hills: A Change of Plans
programme.desc: Når Heidi fikser et intervju for drømmejobben som får henne til å overveie å hoppe av skolen permanent, forstår Lauren at hun og Heidi kanskje har helt forskjellige mål.

programme.title: The Hills: An Unexpected Call
programme.desc: Teen Vogue sender Lauren på et oppdrag til New York City, men vel tilbake i L.A. venter det henne en stor overraskelse fra fortiden. Heidi skjønner at å jobbe med festreklamering ikke bare er en fest.

programme.title: The Hills: Lauren and Jason: Part 2
programme.desc: Da Jason, Laurens eksflamme fra Laguna Beach, dukker opp igjen i livet hennes, forstår hun at hun kanskje ikke er så ferdig med ham som hun trodde. Samtidig, i sin nye jobb, spør Heidi seg om det egentlig er verdt alt strevet.

programme.title: The Hills: Jason's Birthday
programme.desc: Lauren haster hjem fra en lang Teen Vogue-event for å være sammen med Jason på bursdagen hans, men kvelden blir ikke som forventet. Audrina ber Heidi om råd rundt hennes nyeste date, modellen og skuespilleren Danny.

programme.title: The Hills: Boyfriends and Work Don't Mix
programme.desc: Jason utvikler seg til å bli et forstyrrende moment i Laurens profesjonelle og akademiske liv. Heidi får endelig mulighet til å jobbe i nattklubbene, men tidspunktet kunne ikke ha vært dårligere.

programme.title: The Hills: Somebody Always Has to Cry
programme.desc: Det er gjengens første ferie i L.A. og ikke alle får det de ønsket seg. Et nyttårskyss skal vise seg å bli litt av en oppgave for Lauren, når Jason finner ut at hun fikk en uventet telefon fra en gammel flamme.

programme.title: The Hills: You Can't Just Be With Me?
programme.desc: Jason vil gjerne gjøre Laurens 20-årsdag spesiell, men når hun lyver for ham angående en jobb med mannelige modeller for et Teen Vogue-oppdrag, settes forholdet deres på prøve.

programme.title: The Hills: Love is Not a Maybe Thing
programme.desc: Heidi bestemmer endelig at hun har opplevd nok dramatikk med Jordan. Lauren og Jason tenker på å gå et hakk videre.

programme.title: Ex On The Beach US: The Final Crush
programme.desc: Deltakerne må håndtere resultatene av løgndetektortestene sine. De må nå ta den ultimate avgjørelsen: Skal de dra hjem med ekskjæresten, den neste kjæresten eller alene?

programme.title: Ex On The Beach US: Reunion
programme.desc: Singler og ekser gjenforenes for første gang siden den enedelige crush-seremonien. Ashley Iaconetti og Jared Haibon er programledere. Vi finner ut hvilke par som stadig er i hvetebrødsfasen, som har slått opp eller har glidd tilbake i eksens seng.

programme.title: Ex On The Beach: Body SOS: Paige & Sam
programme.desc: Paige vil ikke bestemme bryllupsdato før hun kvitter seg med noen kilo, og Sam vil bli veltrent for å kunne bli modell. Rekker de å forvandle seg før de må vise seg frem i Ex on the Beach?

programme.title: Ex On The Beach: Body SOS: Jourdan & Liam
programme.desc: Jourdan vil gå ned i vekt for å gjenoppdage Beyoncé-kurvene sine og Liam vil bli veltrent for å kunne bli skuespiller. Rekker de å forvandle seg før de skal vise seg fram i Ex on the Beach?

programme.title: Ex On The Beach: Body SOS: Deano & Paris
programme.desc: Deano er desperat etter å bli kvitt mannebrystene og bli like veltrent som kompisene, og kanskje få seg date. Paris øsker å temme kurvene og få tilbake selvtilliten. Men vil de klare forandringene før deres Ex on the Beach-avsløring?

programme.title: Pimp My Ride: 1985 Ford Ranger
programme.desc: I dette avsnittet pimper teamet fra West Coast Customs Jareds Ford Ranger. Jared ruller i vei tre tommer lavere, nylakkert i metallic oransje.

programme.title: Pimp My Ride: Pontiac Trans Am
programme.desc: I dette avsnittet pimper West Coast Customs Danelles Pontiac Trans Am. Hun triller i vei i en bil utstyrt med kaffetrakter og krystallkrone.

programme.title: Pimp My Ride: 1974 Chevy Luv
programme.desc: I dette avsnittet pimper gjengen fra West Coast Customs Neils Chevrolet LUV Truck. Han triller av gårde i et campingtelt på hjul.

programme.title: Pimp My Ride: 1989 Ford Mustang
programme.desc: I dette avsnittet pimper gjengen fra West Coast Customs Shondas Ford Mustang Convertible. Hun ruller i vei i et pimpet og helt trafikksikkert kjøretøy.

programme.title: Pimp My Ride: Maxima Station Wagon
programme.desc: I dette avsnittet pimper teamet fra West Coast Customs Ezras Nissan Maxima Station Wagon. Han kjører av gårde i en mobil DJ-bås.

programme.title: Pimp My Ride: Volkswagen Baja
programme.desc: I dette avsnittet pimper teamet fra West Coast Customs Krissys Volkswagen Baja Bug. Boblen fra 1969 ble konstruert med holdbarhet som mål. Men med sitt bøyde eksosrør og sine ødelagte dører, kan den virkelig beskrives som alt annet enn akkurat det.

programme.title: Pimp My Ride: 1987 Honda CRX
programme.desc: I dette avsnittet pimper teamet fra West Coast Customs Brians Honda CRX. Det er den første bilen som får en splitter ny motor, ettersom den gamle dør innen Xzibit får den inn på verkstedet.

programme.title: Pimp My Ride: '72 Landcruiser
programme.desc: Gaby var en nylig dumpet yogainstruktør som ikke hadde noe i verden utenom yogamatten sin og sin Land Cruiser fra 1972. Ekskjæresten solgte bilen til henne for 200 dollar. Gutta begynner å jobbe med utsiden...

programme.title: Pimp My Ride: 1989 Ford Escort
programme.desc: I dette avsnittet pimper gjengen fra West Coast Customs Kerrys Ford Escort. Bilen var blitt sveiset og "limt sammen" av to separate biler. Gjengen mente den var trafikkfarlig...

programme.title: Pimp My Ride
programme.desc: Xzibit takes a beat-up 1984 Cadillac Eldorado and restores it to it's former glory.

programme.title: Boligkjøp i blinde Danmark: Episode 304
programme.desc: Pernille og Nicklas fra Odense bor så lite at hvis de trenger litt privatliv, så har de bare toalettet å ty til. Nicklas drømmer om å få et kjøkken med to ovner, slik at han kan lage mer mat.

programme.title: Boligkjøp i blinde Danmark: Episode 305
programme.desc: Wendy og Jesper fra Kalundborg bor allerede bra, i en leilighet som har en utrolig utsikt. Men en kommende familieforøkelse betyr at de må finne noe som er større.

programme.title: Boligkjøp i blinde Danmark: Episode 306
programme.desc: Jonas og Louise får sjokk når de ser hvilke hus de har råd til. Mads Mikkelsen og Tobias Edlev Nielsen jobber overtid for å prøve å oppfylle parets ønsker.

programme.title: Boligkjøp i blinde Danmark: Episode 307
programme.desc: Mads og Mia ønsker å flytte litt utenfor byen - men ikke helt på landet. Med Tobias og Mads sin hjelp kjøper de en bolig som har nøyaktig alt de ikke liker.

programme.title: Boligkjøp i blinde Danmark: Episode 401
programme.desc: I første episode møter vi Tine og Lars, som har svimlende åtte millioner å kjøpe hus og pusse opp for. Men det store budsjettet har ikke hjulpet dem så langt - kan ekspertene være til hjelp?

programme.title: Geordie Shore: Big Birthday Battle: Chloe Finds A Dinosaur
programme.desc: Når to nye fjes kommer inn av døra, spisser konkurransen seg til! Det er kappløp til pulehulen, men vinner Aron og Marnie eller Chloe og Marty? Gary viser Charlotte en hengivenhet hun aldri har sett før, men er alle glade på deres vegne?

programme.title: Geordie Shore: Big Birthday Battle: First Date
programme.desc: Sjefen Anna blir rasende når hun ser pinlige gamle klipp, og huset er blitt rasert! To gamle romkamerater kastes inn igjen, og Marty blir forbanna på Chloe. Gary overgår seg selv på en date med Charlotte.

programme.title: Geordie Shore: Big Birthday Battle: Holly's Dream Comes True
programme.desc: Hollys drømmer går i oppfyllelse når en fra fortiden hennes kommer gående inn døren, men hvordan vil resten reagere? Charlottes lag sverger hevn over Garys, men vil de klare å gjennomføre det?

programme.title: Geordie Shore: Big Birthday Battle: Charlotte Messes Up
programme.desc: Scotty T er tilbake og alle i huset jubler! En S&M-kveld på jobben gjør Charlottes lag kåt, og en dum tabbe gjør at Gary må forlate huset. Betyr det slutten på ham og Charlotte?

programme.title: Jersey Shore: Good Riddance
programme.desc: Trekanten blir mer intens når Ronnie tar Sammy i å gi nummeret sitt til en annen gutt. En deltaker velger å forlate The Shore for godt.

programme.title: Jersey Shore: Fade to Black
programme.desc: Paulie og Mike må sjonglere flere grupper med jenter. Det blir slåsskamp i baren, og en av deltakerne blir slått ned.

programme.title: Jersey Shore: Just Another Day at the Shore
programme.desc: Med støtte fra de fleste av de andre er Snooki på bedringens vei. Ronnies familie kommer på besøk, og Sammi ønsker å gjøre et godt førsteinntrykk. JWoww blir lei folkene i klubben og havner i slåsskamp.

programme.title: Jersey Shore: Boardwalk Blowups
programme.desc: Mike ber jenter til huset, og situasjonen kommer ut av kontroll. Snooki havner i slåsskamp igjen. Ronnie havner også i bråk, og Sammi begynner å tvile på forholdet deres.

programme.title: Jersey Shore: What Happens in the AC
programme.desc: Gjengen drar til Atlantic City, der moro blir til alvor idet Mike støter fra seg både Snooki og Jwoww. En av deltakerne avslører at hun har hatt spiseforstyrrelser.

programme.title: Ridiculousness: Sterling og Rocsi Diaz XXX
programme.desc: I denne episoden av 'Ridiculousness' er Rob, Steelo og gjestende vert Rocsi Diaz veldig oppmerksomme men gjør likevel 'Forsiktige feil', mister taket på 'Overdimensjonert last' og drar sin vei med stil i 'Smidige avskjeder'.

programme.title: Ridiculousness: Sterling og Rocsi Diaz XXXI
programme.desc: I denne episoden av 'Ridiculousness' flipper Rob, Steelo og Rocsi Diaz ut i 'Halvt baklengs', setter seg på 'Billige stoler' og ser hvem som får seg en 'Dekksmekk'.

programme.title: Ridiculousness: Sterling og Rocsi Diaz XXXII
programme.desc: I denne episoden av 'Ridiculousness' tilbringer Rob, Steelo og Rocsi Diaz en smertefull dag på vannet i 'Båtknekt', går ut og blir 'Terrassevrak' og manifesterer en del smeller i 'Dårlig tiltrekning'.

programme.title: Ridiculousness: Sterling og Rocsi Diaz XXXIII
programme.desc: I denne episoden av 'Ridiculousness' passer Rob Dyrdek, Steelo Brim og Rocsi Diaz godt på bakdelene sine, så de ikke blir 'Rumpestukket', tar rare omveier for å unngå 'Ville veisperringer' og går tilbake til Robs røtter med 'Skaterhatere'.

programme.title: Ridiculousness: Daymond John II
programme.desc: I kveldens episode av 'Ridiculousness' møter Rob, Steelo, Lolo Wood og gjest Daymond John nifse haier i 'Finneskrekk', vil ikke investere i folk som er 'Ikke banebrytende' og finner ut hva som skjer når man tar 'Slurvete snarveier'.

programme.title: Ridiculousness: Daymond John III
programme.desc: I denne episoden av 'Ridiculousness' får Rob Dyrdek, Steelo Brim, Lolo Wood og gjest Daymond John pengerådgivning av 'Mini-Daymonds', møter noen rasende bier som skaper 'Biebataljer' og tester produkter i 'Prøv før du kjøper'.

programme.title: Ridiculousness: Sterling og Lolo Wood XLI
programme.desc: I denne episoden av 'Ridiculousness' blir Rob, Steelo og gjestevert Lolo Wood rådløse på sjøen og blir helt 'Havkorka', kaster for mange erteposer i 'Villvest-Cornhole' og må jobbe med egen tålmodighet fordi de 'Avskyr å vente'.

programme.title: Steve Ronin

programme.title: Exploring With Josh

programme.desc: Et svart hull lar Dylan kommunisere med sin tidligere forlovede, 300 år tidligere.

programme.title: Andromeda: En rose i asken
programme.desc: Dylan er fengslet på en fengselsplanet og må utføre en flukt mens mannskapet hans prøver å redde dem.

programme.desc: Sydney og Nigel drar til Nepal for å gjenopprette Buddhas fantastiske, overfylte almisse-skål for landsbyboere som bygger en helligdom til den opprinnelige Buddha.

programme.desc: Når Sydneys fly krasjer, blir hun bedt av en gruppe nonner om å finne hodet til en annen nonne som ble halshogd for flere århundrer siden.

programme.title: Relic Hunter: Smoking Gun
programme.desc: Sydney og Nigel søker etter Al Capones diamantkledde pistol på oppdrag fra en mann som håper det vil fjerne bestefaren for et drap han var innrammet for.

programme.title: Relic Hunter: Affaire de Coeur
programme.desc: Sydney og Nigel drar til Skottland for å finne den andre ringen av paret Twining Rings of Calum og Elena.

programme.title: Andromeda: Dobbel helix
programme.desc: Andromeda blir involvert i en strid mellom en enn planeten og en Nietzschean-koloni.

programme.title: Walker Texas Ranger: Korsfarer
programme.desc: Når ekskona til en syk profesjonell bryter går i dekning etter å ha vært vitne til et brutalt drap, må bryteren ta seg av sin sønn.

programme.title: Walker Texas Ranger: I Guds hender
programme.desc: Trivette tror han er ansvarlig for å ha skutt en seks år gammel gutt ved et uhell, og blir suspendert mens etterforskningen pågår.

programme.title: Walker Texas Ranger: Undercover
programme.desc: Walker og Trent Malloy frykter for livet til deres gode venn, etterforsker Carlos Sandoval, når han går undercover som narkolanger og lederne for narkooperasjonen avslører hvem han er.

programme.title: Walker Texas Ranger: Hverdagshelter
programme.desc: Når en skambanket kvinne gir myndighetene informasjon om ektemannens narkotikafremstilling, må Walker beskytte henne fra ektemannens vrede.

programme.title: Walker Texas Ranger: Krigere
programme.desc: En bioingeniør, som har oppdaget et avansert DNA som kan sette en stopper for alle genetiske sykdommer, blir kidnappet av medlemmer av et nådeløst komplott.

programme.title: Mission: Impossible: The Play
programme.desc: With Phelps and Rollin as the leading men, the Impossible Missions Force stages an anti-American play which could prove to be a strong propaganda device for the enemy.

programme.title: Mission: Impossible: The Cardinal
programme.desc: An army commander (played by guest star Theodore Bikel) plots to become dictator by imprisoning an influential cardinal and using a look-alike actor for a public endorsement.

programme.title: Mission: Impossible: The Elixir
programme.desc: The Impossible Missions Force offers a "fountain of youth" to the vain and dictatorial widow (guest star Ruth Roman) of the late president of a small South American country in order to depose her.

programme.title: Mission: Impossible: The Exchange
programme.desc: Cinnamon is captured and the enemy discovers the one thing that would unmask her identity and expose the Impossible Mission Force.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Skåne
programme.desc: Tareq Taylor explores his own backyard of Skåne and hometown of Malmö, a multi cultural food mix. Here you can find food and culture from all over the world that makes it a unique culinary destination.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Best Of
programme.desc: Tareq Taylor looks back on some of the food adventures he has been part of in the program series Nordic Cookery. Tareq promises delicacies from all over the Nordics and meetings with fantastic people along the way.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Läckö & Kinnekulle
programme.desc: By Lake Vänern you find Läckö and Kinnekulle, an area rich in history, culture and traditions. Tareq cooks exciting dishes on vendice roe, fish and local cheeses - all served on porcelain from the world-famous Rörstrand.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Sjuhärad
programme.desc: Sjuhärad is nature and culture in perfect symbiosis. Tareq takes the bike to meet some of the food entrepreneurs in the area who have started exciting new businesses. Here you live close to nature, forest and lakes.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Greater Copenhagen
programme.desc: Copenhagen and Skåne are a hot food destinations. Tareq visits Østergro, Denmark's first "rooftop farm" in the middle of Copenhagen, Eden in the new district Hyllie, Malmö and Häckeberga Castle where there will be wild boar for dinner.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Höganäs
programme.desc: The wild coast at Kullaberg in Skåne has a lot of culture and gastronomy to offer. Fantastic ceramics, vineyards and world-class ice cream. Tareq visits VikenTomater and cooks vegetarian ragù

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Karlstad
programme.desc: Tareq visits sunny Karlstad! Here, food is prepared by Vänern's shores and in Värmland's deep forests. Butter-fried Zander, crepes and cooking over an open fire are on the menu.

programme.title: The Love Boat: The Second Time Around, Hello, Spencer, Runaway, Go Home
programme.desc: Emily Haywood (Marion Ross) returns for a second consecutive cruise as her affection for Captain Stubing grows and Larry Gatlin and the Gatlin Brothers try to help a teenage stowaway.

programme.title: The Love Boat: Couples, The Art Lover, Made For Each Other
programme.desc: Gopher breaks a priceless statue while trying to impress a woman. Judy is blamed for wrecking a marriage, and Ace gets into trouble with two couples.

programme.title: The Love Boat: Second Banana, The Prodigy, What Goes Around Comes Around

programme.desc: Chaim Rumkowski, leader of the Lodz ghetto during WWII, believed cooperation with the Nazis could save lives, providing labor in exchange for food. This approach kept some semblance of community and culture alive amidst unimaginable horror.

programme.title: Weapons That Changed the World
programme.desc: Tanks have transformed warfare since their debut a century ago. Host Wil Willis traces their evolution from World War One breakthroughs to modern marvels like the M1 Abrams, the world's most powerful Main Battle Tank.

programme.title: Nazi Collaborators: The Belgian Collaborator
programme.desc: Leon Degrelle, a charismatic Belgian leader, joined the Nazis and led Die Wallonien on the Eastern Front. Despite no military background, he earned the Knight's Cross for valor. He recruited 4000 more for the SS, defending Berlin until April 1945.

programme.title: Gabulosis: The Apartment That Keeps a Secret: What Happened to Anne Manchester?
programme.desc: On July 8, 1980, Andrew and Joyce Manchester returned from vacation to discover their 26-year-old daughter Anne had been missing for 10 days. She vanished without a trace and was never seen again.

programme.title: Rachel Shannon True Crime
programme.desc: A 14-year-old vanishes on her walk home from school. Nine months later, she shows up alive and names her kidnapper. A solved true crime case that is harrowing, suspenseful, and an extraordinary story of a young girl's survival.

programme.title: Gabulosis: Weld County Jane Doe: She Waited 51 Years to Be Named
programme.desc: In November of 1973 female skeletal remains were found in a creek in Colorado. Her identity was restored after 51 years but authorities are still asking the public for help piecing together her story.

programme.title: Mollie Westbrook
programme.desc: In 1967, 75-year-old widow Louisa Dunne was raped and strangled in her Bristol home. The case remained unsolved for 57 years until DNA evidence led to the 2025 conviction of 92-year-old Ryland Headley.

programme.title: Gabulosis: Canada's Oldest Investigation Solved By Genetic Genealogy
programme.desc: In June 2006, construction workers in Sutherland, Saskatoon, Canada uncovered the remains of an unidentified woman from the early 1900s. Her name and story remained a mystery for another 19 years.

programme.title: Gabulosis: Florida’s Oldest Missing Child Case That Still Has No Answers: The Puzzling Case of "Jon Jon" Hagans
programme.desc: On June 11, 1968 Jonathan "Jon Jon" Hagans vanished from Jacksonville Beach during a day out in the sun with his loved ones. Authorities wanted to say the waves swept him away but his family never agreed with that theory.

programme.title: Rachel Shannon True Crime
programme.desc: Sydney Loofe went on a Tinder date and never came home. The investigation uncovered a calculated murder planned by two predators. A solved true crime case that will stay with you.

programme.title: Rachel Shannon True Crime
programme.desc: A man meets a woman on Facebook who says she needs help. Hours later, his throat is slashed and he's thrown off a bridge into a river. Against all odds, he survived. A solved true crime case that is savage, predatory, and an incredible story of survival.

programme.title: As the Tide Turns
